# Rule quality report - Release Management tool

*Generated by `agent-layer/tests/rule_quality.js` - do not edit by hand.*

**Status (2026-10-10): the whole-word + vocabulary rule set (proposal B) and the negation guard were ADOPTED into the tool (decisions Q-1, Q-2, Q-3, approved by James). "BEFORE" is the original rules, "NOW" is what the tool does today.**

**How to read this.** Each labelled phrase says which concept(s) a release / defect manager would say it is about (labels were written by intent, without looking at the rules' results, by Claude - they still need a practitioner's review). A rule is *right* when it fires for phrases about its concept and stays quiet otherwise. **Engine-correct** counts phrases where the hint actually shown (first match wins) is the one a person would expect (or none). The corpus and the adopted rules were written by the same author, so NOW is optimistic, and the corpus deliberately over-represents hard cases - do not read the percentages as production accuracy.

### How the original rules went wrong (fixed by the adopted set unless listed under "still wrong now")

**Rule 0 - payment / financial system**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Update PFX certificate on web tier"; "Finance team intranet page text update"; "Trading card game promo banner"
* *Missed:* "Stripe webhook listener update"; "PayPal button integration"; "BACS file export change"; "Apple Pay support"; "SEPA direct debit mandate update"; "Refund processing flow"; "Payout schedule change for merchants"; "Direct debit collection run"; "Wire transfer limits update"

**Rule 1 - authentication / identity**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Author bio page layout"; "Association directory listing"; "Lessons learned page update"; "Authority matrix document refresh"; "Brand identity refresh on landing page"; "Remove old test credential from docs"
* *Missed:* "Okta tenant migration"; "Biometric sign-in"; "Single sign-on certificate renewal"; "Passkey support"

**Rule 2 - database / schema / data store**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Billing engine migration"; "Okta tenant migration"; "Index page copy update"; "Elastic scaling of web tier"; "Subindex tidy in the style guide"
* *Missed:* "Alter table orders add column"; "Backfill job for legacy rows"

**Rule 3 - emergency / hotfix**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Step1 onboarding screens"; "Non-urgent tidy-up of release notes"; "Not an emergency: routine monthly release"; "Stop1 sign replacement documentation"
* *Missed:* "Out-of-band security patch"

**Rule 4 - mobile delivery**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Scenarios documentation update"; "Studios booking page"; "Radios catalogue update"; "Curiosity-driven reading list"
* *Missed:* "iPhone widget"

**Rule 5 - personal data / GDPR / privacy**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Unicode font support"; "Mexico office opening banner"
* *Missed:* "Customer address book import"; "Date-of-birth field added to profile"; "Email preference centre"

**Rule 6 - third-party / supplier dependency**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Non-vendor internal tooling clean-up"; "Saaslike naming guideline for modules"
* *Missed:* "Salesforce integration"

**Rule 7 - pilot / limited release**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Previews of attachments are slow to open"

**Rule 8 - decommission / sunset**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Remove old test credential from docs"; "Geolocation lookup service"; "Remove typo from footer"; "Remove duplicate button"; "Turn off animations for reduced motion setting"

### How the original rules went wrong (fixed by the adopted set unless listed under "still wrong now")

**Rule 0 - crash / outage / unavailable**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Download button misaligned"; "Countdown timer shows wrong colour"; "Markdown preview strips tables"; "Breakdown chart legend unclear"; "Fee shown as £500 instead of £50"; "Export contains 5000 rows instead of 500"
* *Missed:* "Server falls over under load"; "Blank white screen on launch"; "SFTP file transfer to partner fails"; "Silicon supply feed fails to refresh"; "Dependency injection container fails to start"

**Rule 1 - payment / financial impact**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Discard changes dialog text wrong"; "Scorecard colours hard to read"; "SFTP file transfer to partner fails"; "Fundamentals tab missing from course page"; "Cardinality warning in query planner"; "Misaligned margin on card layout"
* *Missed:* "Fee shown as £500 instead of £50"; "Direct debit mandate not created"; "Total shown as £401 instead of £410"; "Incorrect calculation of VAT on invoice"

**Rule 2 - authentication / access**
* *Fired when it should not:* "App not responding after login"; "Author name truncated in article list"; "Lessons learned page returns 404"; "Association list not sorted alphabetically"; "Total shown as £401 instead of £410"; "Possession field label typo on form"; "CSRF token missing on form"

**Rule 3 - data loss / integrity**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Deleted items folder label has a typo"
* *Missed:* "Export contains 5000 rows instead of 500"; "Total shown as £401 instead of £410"; "Records overwritten by concurrent edit"; "Duplicate rows created on import"; "Edge case in rounding of ledger totals"

**Rule 4 - performance**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Slow motion animation preference ignored"; "Timeout setting label unclear in preferences"
* *Missed:* "Cardinality warning in query planner"; "Laggy scrolling on long lists"

**Rule 5 - cosmetic**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Silicon supply feed fails to refresh"; "Marginal gains report returns empty"; "Typology classifier misfires on short input"
* *Missed:* "Download button misaligned"; "Breakdown chart legend unclear"; "Discard changes dialog text wrong"; "Author name truncated in article list"; "Overwritten placeholder text in input looks odd"; "Timeout setting label unclear in preferences"

**Rule 6 - browser / device specific**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Token expired errors on mobile"; "Sign in button unresponsive"; "Knowledge base search returns nothing"; "Acknowledge button does nothing on click"; "Scenarios page is empty"; "Edge case in rounding of ledger totals"

**Rule 7 - security vulnerability**
* *Fired when it should not:* "Dependency injection container fails to start"; "SLA breach alert not firing"; "Camera exposure slider has no effect"
* *Missed:* "Hardcoded secret in repository"; "Open S3 bucket with customer files"

## Limits of this measurement

* Labels are one author's judgement; several phrases are marked with a note in the corpus.
* The corpus is small (a few dozen phrases per rule) and written to include known substring traps; NOW was tuned by the author who wrote the corpus.
* Substring and keyword matching can never be a classifier: the hints are prompts for a human, and the tool now says so on every hint ("a keyword match, not an assessment").
